text:
Done — I added task comments support.

What changed:
- Added a comments field to tasks in the API and database flow.
- Added a new endpoint to post a comment to a task: `POST /api/tasks/:id/comments`.
- Updated task retrieval so comments come back when reopening a task.
- Updated the frontend task UI to open a task and show its comment list.
- Added a comment form in the task modal flow.
- Extended the test mock DB and added a test covering comment creation and retrieval.

If you want, I can also add a small comment count badge to each task card.
